name: designed
description: Use for front-loaded design: iterate a mockup with an agent, get stakeholders to agree on it and on the plan, then let agents implement, review, and open the PR. The front-loaded flow for work whose shape matters enough to see before anyone builds it. Not for work that is already obvious enough to just build (shaped, planned) or whose outcome is not yet chosen (research).

stages.name: mockup
stages.description: Agent builds an HTML mockup of the task and publishes it as an artifact

stages.name: stakeholder
stages.description: Gate with no role: stakeholders read the mockup in the artifact viewer and record their decision; approve advances to plan, and an operator sends the task back to mockup (kanna_request_revision, target "mockup") to iterate

stages.name: plan
stages.description: Planning agent turns the approved mockup into an implementation plan
stages.prompt:
$TASK_PROMPT

When you record this plan's result, also publish the remaining stages it chose: on the same kanna_complete_stage call, pass `expected_definition` (the workflowDefinition you read, e.g. via kanna_get_task) and `workflow_definition` (that same document with the stages after plan — "in progress", "review", "pr" and "pr-review" — set to what this plan actually calls for) so the task's remaining plan is formally replaced through the T1 remaining-plan replacement contract, and confirm `workflowExtended: true` in the response. This applies on the workflow's first entry and, if the review stage's "replan" exit sends you back here with a revised plan, on that revised-plan visit too — replan returns here precisely so the remaining stages get republished against the new plan.

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the approved plan; the transition commits its work

stages.name: review
stages.description: Review agent checks quality and coverage, choosing the revision target by the nature of the findings, before the human reads the verdict
stages.prompt: Review branch $BRANCH against base $BASE_REF. This workflow routes results by named exits, not kanna_request_revision (which this task refuses for agent-origin calls). Record your verdict with kanna_complete_stage: status "success", your findings as the message, and an exit chosen by the nature of the blocking findings: "revise" for implementation defects, back to "in progress" as usual; "replan" when the plan itself is structurally wrong, back to "plan". A pass is status "success" with no exit, which advances to pr once a person confirms it. Never call kanna_request_revision on this task.

stages.name: pr
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the reviewed work on branch $BRANCH.

stages.name: pr-review
stages.description: PR reviewer briefs the human on the pull request, then hands off to the merge master
